summary: Found by comment-reduction batch 30 (2026-09-26) and reported without changing code. (1) WriteRollup still writes via a fixed path+".tmp", the same collision class ADR-0049 N14 fixed for rule writes. It is safe today only because one orchestrator writes each workspace's summary once. (2) Recorder.Record calls appendLedgerLine outside its mutex, so concurrent Record calls in one process each open the ledger separately with O_APPEND, which the documented invariant does not cover. (3) TestRuleFiles_AbsentOnlyAndCorruptSafe never exercises the absent-only write its name claims. (4) Outside the package: core/cyclerun_correction.go:85 points readers at interaction/correction.go for reasoning that now lives in docs/architecture/packages/internal-interaction.md, and a test-inventory row names the old result code prompt_cleared.
